annotation.authors_or_issuer: Senate Select Committee on Adopting Artificial Intelligence (AI), Parliament of Australia
key_provisions_or_claims: Senate established the committee on 26 March 2024 to inquire into AI opportunities and impacts for Australia.
Written submissions were called for by 10 May 2024.
Final report deadline was extended from 19 September 2024 to 26 November 2024.
Submissions may be public, name withheld or confidential, and are protected by parliamentary privilege if accepted.
annotation.summary_en: Parliament of Australia inquiry page for the Senate Select Committee on Adopting AI, established 26 March 2024 to examine AI opportunities and impacts. It sets out the submission deadline, the extended reporting date of 26 November 2024, and submission procedures and confidentiality options.
